pieces.Text: You move pieces of heavy armor by concentrating on them.

You move pieces of heavy armor by concentrating on them. The spell exerts a single short, violent thrust. You can hurl one piece of heavy armor per caster level [maximum 15] that are within range and all within 10 feet of each other toward any target within 10 feet per level of all the objects. You can hurl up to a total weight of 25 pounds per caster level [maximum 375 pounds at 15th level]. You must succeed on attack rolls [one per creature or object thrown] to hit the target with the items, using your base attack bonus + your Intelligence modifier [if a wizard] or Charisma modifier [if a sorcerer]. Heavy armor deals 1d6 points of damage per 25 pounds. Armor that misses its target lands in a square adjacent to the target.
Will negates (object) or none; see text
